title: Slovakian Pudding
description: A traditional Slovakian dessert made with creamy pudding and topped with a delightful jubilant sauce. This sweet treat is perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Prepare the Slovakian pudding according to the package instructions.
Mix the jubilant sauce with the milk in a separate bowl.
Split the tender biscuits in half and place them on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the jubilant sauce mixture over the biscuits.
Bake the biscuits in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the warm biscuits with a scoop of the Slovakian pudding.
